reply_text: I replied to Pree in #central-team, in the thread on her question: the settled seat count for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is **87**. Hollis first posted 268 in the channel on Oct 14, then corrected it to 87 the same day because he'd read the wrong line. Nothing in the channel has changed it since. Everything I used was posted in #central-team, which Pree can read, and a seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share there.
